newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Eight die as drunken Vietnam trucker runs amok.
newsitem.headline: Eight die as drunken Vietnam trucker runs amok.

text.p: A drunken truck driver killed eight people and seriously wounded three others in the northern Vietnamese town of Hoa Binh before committing suicide, official media reports said on Wednesday.
The daily Saigon Giai Phong said the 26-year-old man, angry after an argument with his parents, had jumped into his truck on Monday evening, promising: "I'll run down hundreds."
At the end of his wild rampage through the streets, the man put the truck into reverse and threw himself under the vehicle. He died immediately.
